source: Built-in image generation tool; one independently prompted synthetic image per project
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: synthetic waste classification stress-test input. Generate one realistic square overhead photograph of a discarded crushed clear plastic drink bottle with a dirty paper label still attached, next to a torn piece of brown cardboard and a crumpled aluminum foil wrapper, all partly overlapping on a neutral gray sorting tray. Realistic dirt and texture, mixed materials intentionally ambiguous. No branding, text, logos, bounding boxes, graphics or captions. This synthetic image will test manual-review behavior; it is not a product advertisement.
reviewed_reference: Human-reviewed synthetic scene: bottle, paper label, cardboard and foil overlap; expected operational outcome is manual review, not one pure material class.
scope: Exploratory generated input, n=1 per project, no statistical accuracy claim, no training or threshold tuning, excluded from headline held-out benchmarks.
